note.p: See Ed Pope's disussion:SOCIETY FOR CONSTITUTIONAL INFORMATION Mr Thomas Campbell of Princes St, Leicester Sq proposed 27.4.1792 by Walsh 2nded Tooke and Mr Hector Campbell at the Neckinger, Bermondsey proposed SCI 9.11.1792 by Watts 2nded Rae. Both these Campbells in SCI were chemists (as were Walsh and Watts who proposed them). Thomas' will PCC 1810 surgeon and apothecary, Hector's will PCC 1831, Doctor of Medicine. Hector C and Co 27 Horslydown La 1789, active in Div 4 of London Corresponding Society (Thale), ,took out patent for bleaching rags 1794, guilty of libel on Royal College of Physicians 1807 sentenced to 3 months in Kings Bench prison and £50 fine, died at his house in Cheapside 12.1.1831 age 76. Smart, St Andrews University Register Hector Campbell MA and MD 12.1.1796 on testimonials signed by Heinrich Krohn MD and Andrew Marshall MD GODWIN DIARY 17.12.1793 at Woolwich (visiting Muir and Reid in prison hulks) / 28.9.1795 sup at Mrs Johnston's w miss Godwin; Young and Campbell (the top point in the semi-colon between miss Godwin and Young is very tiny, and there is no 'meet', 'adv' or 'see' as Godwin usually applies to names, so Young and Campbell may have been at Mrs Johnston's, or seen just afterwards)
